body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Sony Ericsson(www.sonyericsson.com) introduced new smartphone 'ARC' of its Xperia series at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
'ARC' is Android smartphone which was the ambitious work of Sony Ericsson with Google's latest Android 2.3(Gingerbread) and it's unique Rachael UI will be supported.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
